[[Shaurom]] has concerns about the corsairs slipping past one of his sentries, and asks you to investigate. Follow [[Elonbel]] on his next patrol, but be on your guard.

==Quest Information==

===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
*Follow [[Elonbel]] as he patrols the western riverbank.
*Now that Elonbel's true allegiance has been revealed, deal with him and his cohorts accordingly.
*See Shaurom for your reward.

===Reward===
*500 [[Experience]]
*50 [[gold]]
*5 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s

==Walkthrough==
Exit the [[Sunspear Great Hall]] and travel west to the river to find [[Elonbel]]. Once the player get close, he'll begin his patrol up the river. Along the way, he'll walk by a Level 10 [[Irontooth Drake]] surrounded by a swarm of Level 2 [[Juvenile Bladed Termite]]s. Depending on the levels of the party members, players may want to avoid catching the Irontooth Drake's attention.

Elonbel will walk to camp just outside [[the Astralarium]] where the player finds him meeting with the corsairs. However, they discover Elonbel's been followed, and become hostile.

The corsairs are a minimal threat due to their low levels. However, Elonbel is Level 15 and can deal some moderate damage with his attacks. Low leveled players may want to consider bringing a full party with a Monk. Additionally, keeping the quests [[Quality Steel]], [[Hog Hunt]], and [[Proof of Courage]] active will provide players with additional allies to help as well.

If the player stays out of range, the corsairs and Elonbel will fight each other. Players can use this to their advantage by leaving the corsairs alive to whittle away at Elonbel's health, then finishing them off afterwards.

After defeating Elonbel and the corsairs, return to [[Shaurom]] in the Sunspear Great Hall to receive your reward.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Shaurom
''"Well met, Friends. You've no doubt heard of the corsair raids? Ah, of course you have. I'm sure you've seen your share of corsair action. We've had our own troubles recently, all coming from across the river to the west.''

''I've placed a sentry, '''Elonbel''', in that area, but the raiders seem to be getting past him. Could you follow Elonbel on his next '''patrol''' along the river and see what he does? But, I warn you, if my suspicious are correct, he may be in league with the corsairs. Make yourselves ready for anything."''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = Worry not, Shaurom. The Sunspears will get to the bottom of this.
| decline = I'm sorry, but shouldn't this affair be taken care of internally?
| ask = Follow '''Elonbel''' as he goes to '''patrol''' the river. See where he goes, but be on your guard once you cross the river.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Corsair Commandant:''' ''"It's about time you showed up. I thought maybe you'd betrayed us. Of course, if you had....
:'''Elonbel:''' ''"Save your threats. I have the information you wanted...and I expect to be paid. Now, the main Sunspear patrols are still positioned along the east bank of the river....
:'''Corsair Commandant:''' ''"Did you hear that? Curse you Elonbel, you were followed! To battle brothers!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Shaurom
:''"You have confirmed my suspicions friend. Such a pity, but I have long felt there was more to Elonbel then met the eye. By dealing with him and his corsair allies you have done us all a great service. But I still have concerns there may be other corsairs within our ranks. I fear Elonbel may not have been working alone. We shall have to be doubly vigilant. Thank you for your courage, and may the sun guide you."''

==Notes==
*If the player arrives at the meeting point ahead of Elonbel, the Corsair Commandant may become hostile before the dialogue begins. Defeating him and Elonbel early will stop the Corsair Spotters from spawning. This will prevent the quest from being completed, and the player will have to start again.
